note: Dates follow the standard chronology printed in LDS edition chapter footnotes. Jaredite dates are scholarly approximations — the record gives genealogy, not years.

events.title: The Great Tower
events.blurb: Languages are confounded; the brother of Jared pleads for his family and friends, and the Lord promises a choice land.

events.title: The Lord Touches the Stones
events.blurb: The brother of Jared's faith pierces the veil — he sees the finger, then the whole spirit body, of the premortal Christ.

events.title: 344 Days Across the Sea
events.blurb: Eight sealed barges, 'tight like unto a dish,' are driven by furious winds to the promised land.

events.title: The Long Chain of Kings
events.blurb: Generations of kings rise and fall — captivity, prosperity, secret combinations — as prophets warn and are rejected.

events.title: Ether Prophesies from a Cave
events.blurb: The last prophet cries repentance to Coriantumr: repent, and the kingdom is spared — refuse, and every soul but the king will be destroyed.

events.title: Extinction at Ramah
events.blurb: Millions fall in the final frenzy. Coriantumr smites off Shiz's head, then wanders alone — discovered years later by the people of Zarahemla.

events.title: Lehi Flees Jerusalem
events.blurb: Warned in vision of Jerusalem's destruction, Lehi takes his family into the wilderness, leaving gold, silver, and his inheritance.

events.title: The Brass Plates Obtained
events.blurb: After two failures, Nephi goes 'not knowing beforehand,' finds Laban delivered to him, and secures Israel's scriptures for a new nation.

events.title: Lehi's Dream of the Tree
events.blurb: The tree whose fruit is most precious, the rod of iron, the mists, and the great and spacious building — the record's master allegory.

events.title: The Liahona Appears
events.blurb: A round brass ball of curious workmanship waits at Lehi's tent door — its spindles pointing the way, working by faith and heed.

events.title: Ishmael Buried at Nahom
events.blurb: The party turns eastward after burying Ishmael — hunger, broken bows, and murmuring test every soul.

events.title: Nephi Builds a Ship
events.blurb: In Bountiful by the sea Irreantum, Nephi works ore 'not after the manner of men' while his brothers mock — then tremble.

events.title: Arrival in the Promised Land
events.blurb: After a storm born of rebellion, the ship crosses the great waters and the family plants seeds in a land of promise.

events.title: Lehi Blesses and Dies
events.blurb: 'Adam fell that men might be; and men are, that they might have joy.' Lehi's last blessings close the patriarch's story.

events.title: Nephites & Lamanites Divide
events.blurb: Warned that his brothers seek his life, Nephi departs with all who believe the warnings of God — the great division begins.

events.title: Nephi Likens Isaiah
events.blurb: Nephi copies Isaiah wholesale onto his plates — 'for I did liken all scriptures unto us' — and prophesies of the last days.

events.title: Jacob Reads Zenos's Allegory
events.blurb: The tame and wild olive trees — the longest chapter in the record maps Israel's scattering, grafting, and final gathering.

events.title: Enos Wrestles Before God
events.blurb: A day and a night of prayer in the forest — forgiveness, then concern for his people, then for his enemies.

events.title: Mosiah Discovers Zarahemla
events.blurb: Fleeing the land of Nephi, Mosiah's people find the Mulekite city of Zarahemla — two Jerusalem exoduses reunited.

events.title: Zeniff Returns to Nephi
events.blurb: An over-zealous colony goes back up to the land of their fathers — into three generations of bondage.

events.title: Abinadi Before King Noah
events.blurb: His face shining, Abinadi expounds the law and Isaiah 53, prophesies Noah's death by fire, and seals his words with his own.

events.title: Baptisms at the Waters of Mormon
events.blurb: Alma gathers the believers in the forest — 'to mourn with those that mourn' — and 204 souls covenant in the waters.

events.title: King Benjamin's Address
events.blurb: From a tower over tents of families, the servant-king delivers the angel's words — and his whole people take Christ's name.

events.title: Limhi & Alma Escape Bondage
events.blurb: Limhi's people slip out while the guards sleep off their tribute wine; Alma's people are freed as the Lord deepens the Lamanites' sleep.

events.title: An Angel Stops Alma the Younger
events.blurb: The chief persecutor of the church falls as if dead — and wakes reborn, 'snatched' from an everlasting burning.

events.title: The Reign of the Judges Begins
events.blurb: Mosiah translates the Jaredite record, proposes government by voice of the people, and the era of kings ends.

events.title: Alma Resigns to Preach
events.blurb: Trading the judgment seat for pure testimony, Alma carries the word city to city — Zarahemla, Gideon, Melek, Ammonihah.

events.title: Martyrs & the Fall of Ammonihah
events.blurb: Believers are burned while Alma and Amulek are compelled to watch; months later prison walls fall, and the mocking city is destroyed in a day.

events.title: Ammon at the Waters of Sebus
events.blurb: The missionary-servant scatters the plunderers and carries the severed arms to the astonished king — opening Lamoni's heart.

events.title: The Anti-Nephi-Lehies Bury Their Swords
events.blurb: Thousands of converted Lamanites covenant never to shed blood again — and a thousand die praising God rather than break it.

events.title: Korihor Demands a Sign
events.blurb: The anti-Christ is struck dumb and confesses the devil deceived him — 'and thus we see the end of him who perverteth the ways of the Lord.'

events.title: The Zoramites & the Seed of Faith
events.blurb: From the Rameumptom's vain prayers to Alma's experiment on the word: plant the seed, and taste that it is good.

events.title: The Title of Liberty
events.blurb: Moroni rends his coat and writes upon it — the people come running, rending their garments in covenant, as Amalickiah flees.

events.title: The 2,060 Stripling Sons
events.blurb: Helaman's young Ammonites fight with miraculous exactness — all wounded, none slain — 'they did not doubt; their mothers knew it.'

events.title: Moroni's Letter & Pahoran's Answer
events.blurb: Moroni's furious epistle meets Pahoran's gentle greatness: 'it mattereth not... let us resist evil.' Together they retake Zarahemla.

events.title: Teancum's Last Javelin & Peace
events.blurb: The long war ends with Ammoron slain, Teancum fallen, and Moroni retiring to his own house in peace.

events.title: Gadianton's Band Emerges
events.blurb: Kishkumen's dagger and Gadianton's oaths enter Nephite life — the secret combination Mormon calls the nation's overthrow.

events.title: Nephi Prays from His Tower
events.blurb: Overheard mourning Zarahemla's wickedness, Nephi reveals the chief judge's murder — and receives the sealing power.

events.title: Samuel Prophesies from the Wall
events.blurb: Five years to the signs of Christ's birth; arrows cannot touch him. The Lamanite prophet gives the Nephites their last warning.

events.title: A Night Without Darkness
events.blurb: On the eve of the believers' execution, the voice comes to Nephi: 'on the morrow come I into the world.' The sun sets; no darkness falls.

events.title: The Nephites Gather Against the Robbers
events.blurb: Lachoneus gathers the nation into one place with seven years of provisions; Gidgiddoni starves the robbers' siege into surrender.

events.title: Three Days of Darkness
events.blurb: At the crucifixion: cities burn, sink, and are buried; then a voice in the darkness — 'I am Jesus Christ the Son of God... will ye not now return unto me?'

events.title: The Risen Christ Descends at Bountiful
events.blurb: 2,500 people feel the prints in His hands and feet, one by one. He heals their sick, blesses their children, and angels descend in fire.

events.title: Two Centuries of Peace
events.blurb: No contention, all things common, 'no manner of -ites' — surely there could not be a happier people among all the people created by God.

events.title: Pride Divides Zion
events.blurb: Costly apparel, classes, churches for gain — the old names return, and with them the old hatreds.

events.title: Mormon Takes the Records
events.blurb: A sober child, visited of the Lord at fifteen, leads armies at sixteen — and begins the abridgment that bears his name.

events.title: The Nephites Fall at Cumorah
events.blurb: 230,000 fall. Mormon, wounded among his ten thousand, mourns: 'O ye fair ones, how could ye have departed from the ways of the Lord!'

events.title: Moroni Wanders Alone
events.blurb: 'My father hath been slain... and I even remain alone.' He finishes the record, abridges Ether, and writes to us as if we were present.

events.title: Moroni's Promise & Farewell
events.blurb: 'Ask with a sincere heart, with real intent, having faith in Christ, and he will manifest the truth of it unto you.' The plates are sealed up unto the Lord.
